subject: Deal readiness: weekly GPU allocation standup
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Peter Sanchez <peter.s@orbitai.com>, ops@orbitai.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Deal readiness: weekly GPU allocation standup

Thanks everyone — OrbitAI is moving into their pilot close window (week of 6/23) and we should stand up a short weekly sync to align Sales / Finance / Infra on slot commitments, burst expectations, and the procurement timeline.

Proposed cadence: 30 minutes every Monday through the ramp (flexible if we need to move). Agenda (first pass):
- Forecasted slots needed per week (Sales)
- Reserved vs burst strategy (Infra / Ben)
- Billing/commit terms and invoicing milestones (Finance / Aditya)
- Risk & fallback (cache or lower-capacity model)

I've attached a quick workback and the pipeline snapshot for context. Can the infra and finance folks confirm availability? Peter — are there any procurement constraints on your side we should tie to the schedule?

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Fleet Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: OrbitAI_MCP_Workback.xlsx, pipeline_snapshot_20250618.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Peter Sanchez <peter.s@orbitai.com>, ops@orbitai.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deal readiness: weekly GPU allocation standup

Thanks Grace — I scanned the workback. Quick clarifying Qs before we lock cadence:
- The sheet shows a 3x week-over-week slot ramp starting 6/30. Is the commit for reserved capacity or do they expect burst credits? (affects pool assignment)
- Any hard SLOs for p50/p95 latency we need to guarantee for the pilot? If yes, we should earmark dedicated pool vs best-effort reserved slots.

I'll take the lead on producing a per-week slot ask if you want. I can also add a second tab with a conservative vs aggressive scenario so Finance can map to commit levels.

On calendar availability: Monday mornings are best for me.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Ops — Fleet
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Peter Sanchez <peter.s@orbitai.com>, ops@orbitai.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 12:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deal readiness: weekly GPU allocation standup

+1 to Laura. A few operational notes from infra:
- If OrbitAI wants stable p95 under 400ms for the pilot (and that matches the workback), we should reserve a small dedicated pool starting 6/30 and scale to committed slots by 7/14.
- We have limited burst credits in that week due to scheduled maintenance on the pool; risk of throttling if we rely solely on burst.
- Fallback: we can ship a quantized variant (1.5x cheaper) for non-critical paths to preserve burst headroom.

I'll update the workback with two columns: "Reserved plan" and "Burst-dependent plan". Grace — can you confirm which week the Sales close target is? That'll help prioritize slot assignment.

Ben Carter
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Peter Sanchez <peter.s@orbitai.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, ops@orbitai.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Deal readiness: weekly GPU allocation standup

Thanks — quick update from procurement side: our legal team expects a signed SOW by 7/10 and billing to start the month after signature. We can commit to a 6-week pilot with an option to convert to reserved capacity.

On performance: p50 is fine at current numbers, p95 target is 450ms for the pilot. We can accept a brief canary week where latency spikes are tolerated while scaling.

I'll loop in our procurement lead if needed, but wanted to give you the timeline so you can plan resource handoff.

—Peter
Peter Sanchez
Head of ML Ops, OrbitAI
peter.s@orbitai.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Peter Sanchez <peter.s@orbitai.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deal readiness: weekly GPU allocation standup

Thanks for the clarity, team — summary and next steps: 
1) Weekly 30min standup: Monday 09:30 PT starting 6/23; calendar invite to follow.
2) Laura to produce conservative/aggressive slot ask spreadsheet (ETA: EOD Mon 6/23).
3) Ben to produce reserved vs burst plan and mark maintenance windows (ETA: Tue 6/24).
4) Aditya/Finance to map slot scenarios to invoice milestones and provide two pricing options: pilot month billing vs prepaid reserved credits (ETA: Wed 6/25).
5) OrbitAI to confirm SOW sign target (Peter noted 7/10) and accept a canary week during first ramp.

Attachments I uploaded to the shared Drive: OrbitAI_MCP_Workback.xlsx and the current pipeline snapshot. Please review before Monday — I'll include agenda and a brief rundown in the invite.

If anyone can't make Monday 09:30 PT, call out availability and we'll adjust.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Fleet Strategy
Redwood Inference
